description: This file defines a Todo interface, a TodoFilter type, and a Todos class that manages a list of Todo items with filtering, event handling, and ID generation using nanoid.

classes.name: Todos
classes.description: A mutable, observable container for a todo list that supports filtering, event dispatching, and URL hash-based filtering.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new Todo item with a generated ID and notifies listeners.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a Todo item by ID and notifies listeners.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a Todo item with new data and notifies listeners.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a Todo item by ID.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Toggles all Todo items between completed and active states.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Adds a hashchange event listener to update filter based on URL.

methods.name: filtered
methods.description: Returns the list of Todo items based on current filter.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Getter and setter for current Todo filter.
